texto.@es: **Advise** es el verbo «aconsejar»; **advice** es el nombre «consejo» y no suele llevar **a**: **some advice**, no **an advice**.
texto.@en: **Advise** is the verb «aconsejar»; **advice** is the name «consejo» and does not usually carry **a**: **some advice**, not **an advice**.

texto.@es: **Advise, remind** y **persuade** pueden llevar **persona + to + verbo base**: **advise Nora to check**, **remind Nora to lock**, **persuade Nora to stay**. **Persuade** indica que se logró convencer a alguien.
texto.@en: **Advise, remind** and **persuade** can carry **persona + to + verbo base**: **advise Nora to check**, **remind Nora to lock**, **persuade Nora to stay**. **Persuade** indicates that someone was able to convince.

texto.@es: Para advertir a alguien que no haga algo, usa **warn + persona + not to + verbo base**: **The supervisor warned Nora not to enter**. En esta estructura no uses una orden directa como **don't enter**.
texto.@en: To warn someone not to do something, use **warn + persona + not to + verbo base**: **The supervisor warned Nora not to enter**. In this structure do not use a direct order like **don't enter**.

frases.es: Antes de abrir, la persona responsable aconsejó a Nora, la nueva guía, que revisara todas las salas.

frases.en: The supervisor reminded Nora to lock the side door at six.

frases.en: The supervisor warned Nora not to enter the closed gallery.

analisis.@en: He warned Nora not to come in.

frases.en: Nora wanted to leave early, but the supervisor persuaded her to stay until closing time.
